strategy: Test the personal-finance-mcp server using pytest (the only detected test runner). Unit tests cover pure logic functions (portfolio calculations, parameter sanitization) in isolation. Integration tests cover HTTP API endpoints by starting the ASGI server with httpx TestClient, verifying status codes, payloads, and error scenarios for every /api route. E2E is skipped because the application has no UI and no browser interaction. All P0 and P1 requirements are mapped, and each scenario is assigned to the lowest suitable level without duplication across levels.
